macro.title: FX Shifts
macro.body: The recent fluctuations in the USD/CAD exchange rate could significantly impact the portfolio's value, given its 68% USD exposure. A stronger CAD could lead to decreased returns on USD-denominated assets.
macro.bull: A weaker USD could boost the portfolio's value, especially for USD-denominated assets like FNGU and SPXL.
macro.base: A stable USD/CAD exchange rate would have a minimal impact on the portfolio.
macro.bear: A stronger USD could lead to decreased returns on USD-denominated assets, negatively impacting the portfolio.

risks.title: Leverage Amplification Risk

risks.body: The portfolio's high concentration of tech holdings makes it vulnerable to earnings disappointments or sector-wide downturns.
